name: Shortbow
notes: The archer's starting bow (mw-e05.3), starting numbers from the bead, to be tuned on the archery range (mw-e05.14): full draw in 48 ticks (800 ms); a release before 12 ticks (200 ms) cancels and returns the arrow. Launch speed lerps from 30% to 100% of 60 m/s by draw fraction, so a half draw looses at 39 m/s. Drawing costs 6 stamina; full draw holds free for 120 ticks (2 s), then drains 8 stamina/s until the draw collapses at 0. The archer walks at 50% while drawn. Aim narrows the camera from 70° to 55°.
